svg.title: A to Advertising Campaign Design
svg.desc: A six-and-a-half-second looping animation. A letter A becomes the original A and megaphone artwork, then develops into an advertising campaign across poster, social and digital designs. The original artwork is traced as editable vector paths.
svg.metadata: 5:3 aspect ratio; 1920 by 1080; duration 6.5 seconds; visual traced from 01_A_advertising.png; no external assets.
